name: Collateral 53
definition: Provides for each collateral account the report summary and the valuation of each piece of collateral.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Provides information about the collateral account, that is the identification, the type and optionally the name.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of collateral account for digital assets.

CollateralValuation.name: Collateral Valuation
CollateralValuation.definition: Additional information about the collateral valuation that has been posted.

AccountIdentificationOrBlockChainAddress.definition: If CollateralAccountIdentification is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.
If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, CollateralAccountIdentification must be absent.
Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
